items.title: Corporate Website Design
items.desc: Professional websites that reflect your brand and attract new clients.
items.details:
We build complete corporate websites for all business sectors in Saudi Arabia. We focus on user experience, fast loading, and SEO optimization from day one. You get an easy-to-use content management system with full Arabic and English support. If you need a more flexible CMS, we recommend our WordPress development service. We also offer local SEO services to ensure your site ranks on Google.

In Saudi Arabia, your website is often the first impression potential clients have of your business. With over 98% of Saudis using the internet and most searches starting on Google, a professional corporate website is essential for building trust and attracting new customers. Whether you operate in Riyadh, Jeddah, or Dammam, your online presence determines how easily customers find and choose you over competitors.

Consider a real scenario: a small-to-medium enterprise in the Al-Malaz district of Riyadh needed to attract both individual clients and corporate partners. Their old site was slow, not mobile-friendly, and only in English. After we built a fully bilingual corporate site with a modern, responsive design and SEO built in, their Google traffic tripled within three months. Their new site loads in under two seconds and ranks on the first page for key terms like "شركة تصميم مواقع في الرياض."

Our process starts with a discovery call where we understand your industry, audience, and goals. We then design a sitemap and wireframes, followed by visual design in both Arabic and English. Development takes 1-2 weeks depending on complexity, with built-in SEO from day one. We test across all devices, train your team on the CMS, and deploy with zero downtime.

Every corporate website we build comes with a comprehensive SEO foundation — optimized meta tags, proper heading hierarchy, XML sitemap generation, schema markup for your business type, and fast hosting on Saudi-local servers for minimal latency. We also configure Google Search Console and Google Analytics so you can track performance from day one.

The result is a website that works as your best salesperson — available 24/7, ranking on Google, and converting visitors into leads. You get a modern digital presence that reflects your brand quality and attracts the right clients to your business. Our pricing starts from 1,000 SAR for a 5-page site, with transparent quotes and no hidden fees.

Our team at BOSLA understands the Saudi market because we operate in it every day. We know what works for local businesses and what does not. When you choose us, you get more than a website — you get a partner who cares about your online success, from the first consultation to years of ongoing support.

We stand behind our work with a satisfaction guarantee. If you are not happy with the initial design concepts, we revise them until they meet your expectations. We also provide ongoing support after launch — whether you need to add a page, update content, or troubleshoot an issue, our team is just a WhatsApp message away.

We build every corporate website with conversion in mind. Every page is designed with a clear purpose — whether to inform, persuade, or prompt action. Contact forms are prominently placed, WhatsApp chat integration is configured for instant communication, and call-to-action buttons are strategically positioned throughout the site. This focus on conversion ensures your website does more than just look good — it actively generates leads and sales for your business.

Mobile performance is a top priority in our development process. With over 95% of Saudi internet users accessing websites via smartphones, we ensure your site loads in under 2 seconds on mobile networks, displays perfectly on every screen size, and provides a touch-friendly navigation experience. Google rewards mobile-optimized sites with better rankings, and users reward them with higher engagement and conversion rates.

We provide comprehensive post-launch support including one month of free technical support, SEO performance monitoring, and regular backups. During this period, we monitor your site for any issues, help your team get comfortable with the CMS, and make any necessary adjustments based on real user behavior. After the first month, you can continue with our affordable maintenance plans starting from just 300 SAR per month.
features: Responsive design that works on all devices

faq.q: How long does it take to build a corporate website?
faq.a: A standard corporate website with 5-10 pages takes 1-2 weeks to design and develop. Complex sites with custom features can take 3-4 weeks. We provide a clear timeline during the consultation phase.

faq.q: Can I update the website myself after it's built?
faq.a: Yes. We build your site on an easy-to-use content management system that lets you update text, images, and pages without any technical knowledge. We also provide a training session to get you started.

faq.q: How much does a corporate website cost in Saudi Arabia?
faq.a: Our corporate website packages start from 1,000 SAR for a simple 5-page site and go up to 3,000 SAR for a fully featured site with custom functionality. We provide a detailed quote after understanding your needs.

faq.q: Do you build bilingual Arabic/English websites?
faq.a: Yes, all our corporate websites come with full bilingual support. We design for both Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) layouts, ensuring a seamless experience for both audiences. Content can be managed independently in each language through the CMS.

faq.q: What information do you need to start building my site?
faq.a: We need your brand assets (logo, colors, fonts), content for each page (text and images), and information about your target audience and business goals. We can also help create content if needed. The process starts with a free consultation call.

items.title: WordPress Website Development
items.desc: Custom WordPress sites with professional themes, plugins, and WooCommerce stores.
items.details:
We develop WordPress websites from scratch—custom themes, bespoke plugins, and full WooCommerce stores with Saudi payment gateways. Your team can easily manage content while you enjoy unlimited scalability. Your WordPress site also needs technical SEO optimization to rank properly. We also recommend a complete brand identity to make your site truly stand out.

WordPress powers over 40% of all websites globally, and in Saudi Arabia it is the most popular CMS for mid-to-large businesses. It gives you complete control over your site functionality without locking you into a proprietary platform. You can start with a simple brochure site and scale to a full e-commerce store with hundreds of products, all on the same foundation.

Take the example of a growing retail business in Jeddah that needed both a corporate website and an online store. We built a custom WordPress theme matching their brand identity, integrated WooCommerce with Mada and STC Pay, and added a booking system for physical store appointments. Their team now manages products, blog posts, and promotions without any developer assistance.

Our WordPress development process is transparent: requirements gathering, theme design, plugin architecture planning, development on a staging server, content population, SEO setup, thorough testing, and deployment. We use version control and follow WordPress coding standards to ensure your site is secure, fast, and maintainable for years.

We use only reputable, well-maintained plugins and follow WordPress best practices for security and performance. This includes implementing a Web Application Firewall, login attempt limiting, regular security scanning, and automatic updates. Your site is protected against the most common vulnerabilities that plague WordPress sites across the GCC region.

You get a WordPress site that grows with your business. Add new features through plugins, expand to multiple languages, integrate with CRM and email marketing tools, and rest assured that your investment is future-proof. With regular updates and our maintenance plans, your site stays secure and performant indefinitely.

WordPress is particularly powerful for content-heavy websites. If your business relies on blogging, publishing resources, or regularly updating content to attract customers, WordPress gives you the best editing experience. Combined with our custom theme development, your site will look unique while benefiting from WordPress mature ecosystem.

Our WordPress development timeline is efficient and predictable. A standard custom theme with 5-10 templates takes 2-3 weeks. Adding WooCommerce or custom functionality extends this to 3-4 weeks. We communicate progress weekly with screenshots and staging site access so you can see your site taking shape.

WooCommerce stores we build are fully equipped for the Saudi market. This includes integration with Mada, STC Pay, Apple Pay, and Tabby buy-now-pay-later. We configure shipping zones covering all Saudi cities and regions, set up tax calculations compliant with ZATCA e-invoicing requirements, and implement inventory management that syncs across multiple warehouses if needed.

Security is built into every WordPress site we develop. Beyond the standard security measures, we implement login page customization to prevent brute force attacks, two-factor authentication for admin accounts, IP blocking for suspicious activity, and regular vulnerability scanning. For e-commerce sites, we ensure PCI compliance for payment processing and encrypt all customer data.

WordPress sites we build are designed for speed from the ground up. We use lightweight, optimized themes, implement caching at multiple levels, optimize images automatically, use CDN integration for faster global delivery, and minimize CSS and JavaScript. The result is a site that scores 90+ on Google PageSpeed Insights, providing an excellent user experience and SEO advantage.

faq.q: Why choose WordPress over a custom-built website?
faq.a: WordPress offers flexibility, scalability, and a vast library of plugins. You can add features like e-commerce, booking systems, and membership areas without starting from scratch. It is ideal for businesses that want to grow their site over time.

faq.q: Can you migrate my existing site to WordPress?
faq.a: Yes, we handle full migrations from any platform to WordPress. We preserve your SEO rankings and content structure during the move. The process typically takes 3-7 days depending on the size of your site.

faq.q: How much does a custom WordPress site cost?
faq.a: Our WordPress projects start from 1,500 SAR for a basic site and range up to 4,000 SAR for a full WooCommerce store with custom features. The exact price depends on your specific requirements.

faq.q: Do you build WooCommerce stores with Saudi payment gateways?
faq.a: Absolutely. We build full WooCommerce stores integrated with Mada, STC Pay, and Apple Pay. We also configure tax calculations, shipping zones, and inventory management for the Saudi market.

faq.q: Can you integrate third-party tools with my WordPress site?
faq.a: Absolutely. We integrate CRM systems, email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, SendGrid), booking systems, payment gateways, analytics tools, and any API-based service. Our custom plugin development ensures seamless integration with your existing workflow.

faq.q: Do you provide training for my team after the site is built?
faq.a: Yes, we provide comprehensive training sessions for your content editors and administrators. This includes how to add/edit pages, manage blog posts, handle e-commerce orders, and perform basic maintenance. We also provide video documentation for reference.

items.title: Online Stores (Shopify - Salla - Zid)
items.desc: Full-featured online stores on Shopify, Salla, or Zid with Saudi payment integration.
items.details:
We build online stores on the best platforms—Shopify, Salla, or Zid—based on your business needs. We integrate Saudi payment gateways (Mada, STC Pay, Apple Pay), inventory management, order tracking, and complete SEO optimization. Once your store is live, e-commerce SEO is essential to appear on Google. We also integrate all Saudi payment gateways for your customers.

The e-commerce market in Saudi Arabia is growing at over 30% annually, driven by high smartphone penetration and a young, digitally-savvy population. Saudi consumers now expect seamless online shopping experiences with local payment options, fast delivery tracking, and Arabic-language support. Choosing the right platform and setting it up correctly from the start determines whether your online store succeeds or struggles.

Consider a fashion boutique in Riyadh that was selling through Instagram DMs and WhatsApp. They were losing sales because customers could not browse products easily or pay online. We built a Shopify store with Mada and STC Pay integration, synced their inventory, and optimized product pages for Google Shopping. Within the first month, their online revenue matched what they were making from Instagram.

Our process begins with platform selection based on your budget, product count, and growth plans. We then design your store theme, upload and optimize product listings with SEO-friendly titles and descriptions, configure payment and shipping zones, and set up tax calculations compliant with ZATCA regulations. We also integrate order tracking and automated customer notifications.

Each platform we work with has specific strengths. Shopify excels at international shipping and app integrations, Salla is built specifically for the Saudi market with local features like Same-Day delivery and Tabby/Tamara installments, and Zid offers excellent customization for growing brands. We guide you to the right choice and then optimize every aspect for maximum sales.

Your online store becomes a 24/7 revenue generator with professional design, smooth checkout flow, and mobile-optimized shopping. With e-commerce SEO and integration with Google Shopping, your products appear when customers search. You get full control over inventory, orders, and marketing from an intuitive dashboard.

Customer trust is critical for e-commerce success. We build trust into every store through professional design, clear return policies displayed prominently, trust badges including Mada and STC Pay, customer review sections, and transparent shipping information. These trust signals can increase conversion rates by 15-30% according to e-commerce research.

We do not just build your store and leave you. Our onboarding includes training on product management, order fulfillment, customer service workflows, and analytics. We provide video tutorials and written documentation so your team can independently manage the store.

Shipping and logistics integration is critical for Saudi e-commerce success. We configure your store with major Saudi logistics providers including Aramex, SMSA, and Zajil for domestic delivery, and integrate with international carriers for global shipping. Real-time tracking, delivery time estimates, and automated shipping label generation streamline your fulfillment process.

Marketing features are built into your store from day one. We configure discount codes, flash sales, bundle deals, buy-one-get-one offers, and loyalty programs that encourage repeat purchases. Email capture pop-ups, exit-intent offers, and social media integration help you build your customer list and drive traffic to your store without additional development costs.

Analytics and reporting give you full visibility into your business performance. We set up Google Analytics 4 with e-commerce tracking, configure conversion goals, implement Facebook and Snapchat pixels for ad retargeting, and create a custom dashboard showing your key metrics — revenue, orders, conversion rate, average order value, and customer acquisition cost.

items.title: Website Redesign & Migration
items.desc: Modernize your existing site to be faster, more secure, and conversion-optimized.
items.details:
We redesign your current website to be more modern, faster, and mobile-friendly. We preserve your SEO rankings during migration and dramatically improve loading speed and user experience. A redesign is the perfect time to fix technical SEO issues. We also offer ongoing maintenance to keep your site fast and secure.

Many Saudi businesses built their websites 3-5 years ago, before mobile-first design and Core Web Vitals became standard. An outdated site costs you money — slow loading times drive away customers, poor mobile experience loses sales, and old design makes your brand look behind the times. Studies show that 53% of mobile users abandon a site that takes longer than 3 seconds to load.

A medical clinic in Dammam came to us with a five-year-old website that was not mobile-responsive and had a 50% bounce rate. Their competitors were ranking higher on Google and capturing their potential patients. We rebuilt their site with a mobile-first approach, optimized images for sub-2-second loading, preserved all existing SEO rankings through proper 301 redirects, and added an online booking system. Their bounce rate dropped to 25% and appointment bookings increased by 60%.

Our redesign process starts with a comprehensive audit of your current site — performance benchmarks, SEO health, content inventory, and user experience issues. We create a redesign plan that preserves what works and improves what does not. Development is done on a staging environment while your live site remains untouched.

Beyond visual improvements, we future-proof your site by implementing modern architecture — responsive design systems, API-first approaches, progressive web app capabilities, and integration readiness for future tools. This ensures your redesigned site stays relevant and adaptable for the next 3-5 years.

You get a modern, fast, and mobile-optimized site that converts better and ranks higher. Your SEO rankings are preserved or improved, your brand looks current and trustworthy, and your customers enjoy a seamless experience. Our clients typically see a 40-60% improvement in page speed and a 20-40% increase in conversions within 90 days.

Technology changes fast, and so do user expectations. A site designed three years ago may not meet current accessibility standards, mobile usability requirements, or browser compatibility needs. Our redesign brings your site up to current standards while future-proofing it with clean code and modular architecture.

We make the redesign process smooth for your team. Your old site stays live throughout development. We build the new site on a staging URL where you can review progress. When everything is approved, we deploy with minimal downtime — typically under 30 minutes.

User experience research guides our redesign decisions. We analyze your current site analytics to identify where users drop off, which pages have the highest bounce rates, and what content drives the most engagement. Heat mapping and session recording tools help us understand exactly how visitors interact with your site so we can redesign with data-driven confidence rather than guesswork.

Content strategy is a critical component of any redesign. We audit your existing content, identify what should be kept, updated, consolidated, or removed, and recommend new content to fill gaps. This ensures your redesigned site not only looks better but communicates more effectively with your target audience and drives them toward desired actions.

Post-launch monitoring ensures the redesign delivers expected results. We track key metrics for 30 days after launch — traffic, rankings, bounce rates, conversion rates, and user feedback. We make data-driven adjustments based on this monitoring period to optimize performance and ensure your investment in redesign delivers maximum return.

faq.q: Will redesigning my site affect my SEO rankings?
faq.a: We use an SEO-preserving migration process that maintains your existing rankings. We map all old URLs to new ones, preserve meta data, and monitor rankings during and after the transition.

faq.q: How long does a redesign project take?
faq.a: A typical redesign takes 2-4 weeks depending on the size and complexity of your site. Simple sites with 10-20 pages can be done in 2 weeks, while larger sites may take longer.

faq.q: Do I need a redesign or just a refresh?
faq.a: If your site is over 3 years old, loads slowly, or is not mobile-friendly, a full redesign is recommended. If it is just the design that feels dated, a visual refresh may be sufficient. We assess your site during the consultation.

faq.q: How much does a website redesign cost?
faq.a: Redesign costs range from 1,000 SAR for small sites to 3,000 SAR for larger, more complex websites. The price depends on the number of pages, features, and whether you are changing platforms.

faq.q: What happens to my existing content during a redesign?
faq.a: We migrate all existing content to the new site and audit it for quality. We recommend updating or removing outdated content and filling any content gaps. Your blog posts, service pages, and product information are all preserved and improved.

faq.q: Can you redesign just part of my site instead of everything?
faq.a: Yes, we offer phased redesigns. You can start with your most important pages (homepage, services, contact) and expand to other sections over time. This approach spreads the cost and allows for iterative improvements based on user feedback.

items.title: Website Maintenance & Support
items.desc: Keep your site secure, fast, and up-to-date with ongoing maintenance plans.
items.details:
We offer comprehensive maintenance packages—security updates, performance monitoring, content updates, and regular backups. Your site stays healthy while you focus on growing your business. We recommend periodic SEO audits to catch issues early. Our redesign service can help if your site needs a major refresh.

A website is like a car — it needs regular maintenance to run smoothly. Without updates, your site becomes vulnerable to security threats, plugins become incompatible, performance degrades, and SEO rankings slip. In Saudi Arabia, where cyber threats increasingly target small and medium businesses, neglecting website maintenance can lead to data breaches and expensive emergency repairs.

We worked with a Saudi e-commerce store that had not updated their WooCommerce site for 18 months. Their site was hacked through an outdated plugin, causing a week of downtime and lost revenue of over 15,000 SAR. After we restored their site from a backup and implemented our comprehensive maintenance plan, they have had zero security incidents in two years.

Our maintenance process is systematic: weekly automated backups stored in multiple locations, monthly security patches and plugin updates, performance monitoring with alerts for any degradation, and content updates as requested typically within 24 hours. We also conduct quarterly security scans and provide a monthly health report.

Our maintenance plans scale with your needs. The basic plan covers essential security and backups starting at 300 SAR per month. The standard plan adds content updates and performance monitoring at 500 SAR. The comprehensive plan includes priority support, monthly SEO health checks, and quarterly performance reports at 800 SAR. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time.

With our maintenance plan, you never have to worry about your website. Security is handled, performance is monitored, content stays fresh, and if anything goes wrong, we restore from backup within hours. Your site remains a reliable, secure, and effective tool for your business.

Security threats are constantly evolving, and keeping your site protected requires ongoing vigilance. Our maintenance team monitors for new vulnerabilities, applies patches promptly, and conducts regular security scans. For e-commerce sites, we pay special attention to payment page security and customer data protection.

Beyond reactive maintenance, we proactively identify opportunities to improve your site. This includes suggesting performance optimizations, SEO improvements as Google algorithm evolves, content updates to keep information current, and technology upgrades when better solutions become available. Our goal is to continuously improve your site.

Our maintenance team handles all technical aspects of your website so you can focus on your business. This includes WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates, PHP version compatibility checks, database optimization for faster queries, spam comment cleanup, broken link detection and fixing, and SSL certificate renewal monitoring. Everything is handled proactively before issues arise.

Content updates are handled quickly and professionally. Whether you need to update pricing, add a new service page, publish a blog post, update team member information, or change images, simply send us the content and we handle the rest. Most content updates are completed within 24 hours, and urgent updates can be done in as little as 2 hours.

Performance reporting gives you complete transparency. Each month you receive a detailed report showing uptime statistics, page speed scores, security scan results, backup status, content updates completed, and any recommendations for improvement. You always know exactly what we have done and what your website health looks like.

faq.a: We apply security patches monthly and update plugins and themes as needed. Critical updates are applied immediately. Content updates can be requested anytime and are typically done within 24 hours.
